builtIn.description: Built-in presets are read-only and cannot be deleted.

ScenarioPack.description: Portable scenario experiment package. It contains manifest, world, rules, scenario, expectations, optional assets, and optional docs; runtime snapshots and local secrets are excluded.

RunCatalogEntry.description: Comparable live, scenario, or benchmark run row. Rows may be merged from runtime JSON and data/replay-store artifacts; artifact rows take precedence for the same runId.

RunArtifactManifest.description: Local artifact manifest persisted under data/replay-store/<runId>. Paths are relative artifact file names, not absolute local paths.

TownMapPack.description: Semantic map package containing manifest, locations, connections, interactions, spawn points, optional assets, and optional docs; runtime snapshots and local secrets are excluded.

TownRuleCatalog.description: Catalog of institutions, professions, detective resources, long action settings, random events, and case pressure rules.
